Jon (Eng): Hey team — quick one. I moved to Berlin on 2027-03-15 and updated my Ripley location that morning, but my March 31 payrun shows US FICA/Medicare still withheld. Shouldn't German social security (Sozialversicherung) apply for the posting period?
Maya (People Ops): Thanks Jon. Did you submit the secondment addendum and any A1 certificate or German sozialversicherung registration before the payroll cutoff?
Jon (Eng): I signed the secondment addendum on 2027-03-14 and uploaded it 03-15 07:45 CET. I requested an A1 via People Ops but haven't received it yet. I also uploaded my Anmeldung (registration) 03-16 after the payrun.
Kai (Payroll): If the A1 wasn't active at payrun snapshot (pr-20270331) system defaulted to US run. We can request a reversal and reissue under German payroll if the advisor says German coverage should have applied. We'll need copies of Anmeldung and the secondment addendum in the private ticket.
Alicia (Tax Counsel): High-level: short-term EU secondments often rely on A1 to keep home-country social security; without A1, local Sozialversicherung may apply. Treaty and social security rules determine which system applies. If German coverage was required on 3/31, corrected filings (German and US) plus a W-2c/941-X may be needed. We'll consult external international payroll advisor.

Jon (Eng): OK. Main concern is timing — I'm applying for a mortgage and need clean docs. How long does a correction take?
Kai (Payroll): Typical timeline: request submitted to external advisor (1-2 business days), advisor review (5-10 business days), then payroll reversals + amended filings (10-30 business days depending on jurisdictions). We'll flag mortgage as time-sensitive to Finance for possible interim support.
Maya (People Ops): I've opened ticket PO-2027-330 and attached the secondment addendum. Jon please DM Anmeldung and passport stamp to the ticket so we don't put PII here.
Alicia (Tax Counsel): Scheduling call with external advisor for 2027-04-04 to confirm A1/Sozialversicherung position. If reversal is appropriate, we'll aim for corrected payroll runs and W-2c. If not, we'll document why and advise on foreign tax credits/refunds.
Kai (Payroll): Submitted reversal request to advisor just now. payroll-bot update pending. We'll keep updates in PO-2027-330.
